title: Add max move count per game
description: No limit on moves per game. Two cooperating clients can keep a room alive indefinitely with pass moves, consuming memory (history_hashes, event log) and a room slot. Fix: add MAX_MOVES_PER_GAME and auto-finish.
close_reason: Added MAX_MOVES_PER_GAME (10000) and MAX_ACTION_FIELD_LENGTH (256). Game rejects moves past limit. Action string fields bounded.
